title: Start with a repository.
body: Connect a repository to choose what ShipCheck can inspect.

title: Your scope. Your control.
body: Choose the repository and branch before starting a scan.

title: Your scan is queued.
body: We will show progress when the worker starts.

title: Checking the selected scope.
body: Collecting dependency and configuration evidence. Results will show what was checked.

title: Findings ready for review.
body: Open each finding to see its source, affected component and available next step.

title: No findings in this scan.
body: This result covers the selected checks and scope. It is not a guarantee that the project is secure.

title: A fix to inspect.
body: Review the proposed changes before running them in an isolated test environment.

title: Testing in isolation.
body: The selected test commands are running against the proposed patch.

title: Configured tests passed.
body: Compare the before-and-after evidence, then decide whether to approve a draft pull request.

title: Verification needs attention.
body: At least one configured check did not pass. Inspect the log before retrying or changing the patch.

title: Ready for your review.
body: Check the diff, test scope and evidence. Approval allows a draft PR; it does not merge or deploy.

title: Draft pull request created.
body: The patch and verification evidence are ready for repository review.

title: Sign in to continue.
body: Your session has expired. Sign in again before requesting another action.

title: Repository access is missing.
body: Check the app installation and repository selection with an owner.

title: One check is unavailable.
body: A provider did not return a usable result. Available evidence is shown separately; this scan is incomplete.

title: Testing paused at the spending limit.
body: Review usage and remaining budget before authorising another run.

title: Decision recorded.
body: Your review decision has been added to the audit trail.

title: Evidence export ready.
body: Review the export for sensitive information before sharing it outside your team.
